characterization_methods: N2 adsorption using the density functional theory
evidence: The self-limiting pore size reduction was confirmed using single-gas permeation measurements on the modified membranes. The permeance of p-xylene was 2.5 × 10-7 molâm-2âs-1âPa-1. The separation of p- over o-xylene was improved from 1 to 2.1 after modification of the mesoporous membrane with C-ALD. The data from N2 permeance (Figures 3 and 5), pyridine permeance, N2/Ar separation (Figure 6), H2/CH4 separation (Figure 7), and xylene separation (Figure 8) strongly indicated that silica was deposited within the pores of the support membrane by catalyzed ALD. The complete details of the support preparation can be found elsewhere.
